timestamp.behavior: MITRE activity records require a valid timestamp.

session_id.behavior: Missing or empty session_id must remain missing and must not be fabricated.

mitre_technique.behavior: MITRE technique may be NULL or empty in raw input. Events without a valid MITRE technique must not be fabricated into a technique category.

attack_type.behavior: Attack type may be NULL or empty in raw input.

attack_stage.behavior: Attack stage may be NULL or empty in raw input.

severity.behavior: Missing severity must remain missing and must not be fabricated.

output.behavior: Output analytics must only contain dimensions and relationships supported by valid source values. Empty source MITRE fields must not be converted into fabricated MITRE values.

deferred_rules: MITRE_ANALYTICS remains DEFERRED until the actual ML event output containing the contracted fields is available.
The current Real ELK dataset must not be assumed to satisfy the MITRE_ANALYTICS input contract.
No MITRE technique, attack type, or attack stage may be fabricated when source values are missing.
Unknown must remain distinct from NULL or empty when it is explicitly present as a source value.
The exact production aggregation implementation is not defined by this contract.
The contract does not assume a specific MITRE enrichment or mapping implementation.
independence_rules: MITRE_ANALYTICS must be read-only with respect to source event data.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not modify source events.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not generate ML features.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not perform feature scaling.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not alter production cluster assignments.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must not fabricate MITRE enrichment.
MITRE_ANALYTICS must operate independently of downstream dashboard consumers.

availability.reason: The current Real ELK dataset does not provide sufficient validated MITRE data to close and execute MITRE_ANALYTICS.
availability.activation_condition: Actual ML event output must be received and validated against the MITRE_ANALYTICS input contract.
